newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Oct 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Former Moslem rebel chief Nur Misuari tokes his oath as governor of the four-province Autonomous Region in Moslem Mindanao in the southern Philippines. (PHILIPPINE DAILY INQUIRER)

- The Senate has subpoenaed a notebook owned by a local talent manager that supposedly contains the names of businessmen and politicians who engaged the sexual services of underage movie stars (MANILA STANDARD)

- The Department of Justice has issued a legal opinion stating that while the United States government may use the 10.6-hectate land it claims to own in the Fort Bonifacio property in Makati, it does not have legal right to possess the property (MANILA TIMES)
- The League of Municipalities of the Philippines pressed for the tunover of administrative and operational control of the police to local government units (MANILA BULLETIN)
